validation.min: Enter a value of at least {min}
validation.max: Enter a value of at most {max}
dashboard.summary: A quick look at what is still owed.
auth.tagline: Bring your business data into one admin console.
auth.setupNote: This is the first launch. Create an administrator account.
auth.loginNote: In Tauri/LAN mode, log in with the account you created at first launch.
auth.demoNotePrefix: The standalone browser (demo) mode lets you log in with
auth.passwordTooShort: Enter a password of at least 8 characters
auth.setupUnsupported: This environment does not support initial setup
settings.pageDescription: Configure this device's behavior: theme, LAN access, backups, and more.
settings.themeDesc: Switch the color mode, preset, and display density.
settings.themeNote: Settings are saved to this device immediately, and while you are logged in they are also saved to the settings DB (Tauri/LAN server) and shared with other clients (spec §12.1 / M12).
settings.languageDesc: Choose the display language for the admin UI.
settings.languageNote: Switching languages reloads the page so every screen updates. Your choice is saved to this device and, while you are logged in, to the settings DB (M12).
settings.vibrancyDesc: Rendering behind the desktop app window (Windows only).
settings.vibrancyNote: Render behind the window with the OS acrylic (frosted glass) effect. Combined with the glass preset, it becomes real glass that lets the desktop show through (M12, Windows only).
settings.lanDesc: Let browsers on other devices on the same LAN use this screen.
settings.lanDisabledByAuth: Unavailable while login-not-required mode is on.
settings.serverDesktopOnly: Server settings can only be changed in the desktop app.
settings.lanNote: When enabled, browsers on other devices on the same LAN can use the same screen via the REST API + SSE (spec §11). Enable it only on a trusted LAN.
settings.autologinDesc: Automatically log in with a specified account at startup (desktop only).
settings.autologinUnneeded: Auto login is not needed in login-not-required mode.
settings.autologinNote: Credentials are stored in the OS keyring. This account is logged in automatically at startup.
settings.auditDesc: Set the retention days and row cap for automatically tidying records.
settings.auditNote: Entering 0 makes that item unlimited (defaults are 90 days / 100,000 rows). Old records are tidied automatically when the list is shown. You can view the record list from the "Audit log" screen.
settings.systemInfoDesc: Check the running version and database status.
settings.systemInfoNote: Read-only diagnostics. The session count is an upper bound and may include expired-but-not-yet-swept sessions.
settings.dangerDesc: High-impact operations. Review carefully before running them.
settings.authDisableNote: Enable it only if you completely trust this device. It cannot be enabled at the same time as LAN access.
settings.authDisableConfirm: Enabling login-not-required mode lets anyone who opens this device operate without logging in. Continue only if you completely trust this device.
settings.passwordChangeUnavailableAuth: In login-not-required mode there is no account, so the password cannot be changed.
settings.passwordChangeUnsupported: This environment does not support changing the password.
backup.heading: Backup / restore
backup.note: Creates an online backup in the backups/ directory next to the DB file (VACUUM INTO, safe while running). Restore verifies the uploaded/selected file (integrity check + schema check), stages it, and applies it automatically at the next startup (it never swaps the running DB). The current DB just before applying is backed up automatically (spec M17).
backup.restoreConfirm:
{source}

The current data is backed up automatically when applied. A restart is required to apply. Continue?
backup.openFolderUnsupported: Not supported on this OS. Open it manually: {path}
audit.pageDescription: A record of user actions and system events.
audit.unavailableDesc: Not available in demo mode. The standalone browser demo mode has no audit-log DB, so this feature is available only in the Tauri app or via LAN access (embedded server).
audit.retentionNote: Retention policy: up to {days} / up to {rows} (change it on the "Settings" screen)
audit.recordCountNote: There are {count} records. Click a row to show details below.
users.pageDescription: Create, edit, delete accounts and reset passwords.
users.unavailableDesc: Not available in demo mode. The standalone browser demo mode has no account DB, so this feature is available only in the Tauri app or via LAN access (embedded server).
users.createDesc: Create an account by specifying a username, password, and role.
users.listDesc: Click a row to show the edit panel on the right.
users.editDesc: Update the display name and role.
users.resetDesc: Set a new password and force it onto this user.
users.deleteDesc: Delete this account permanently. This cannot be undone.
users.selectHint: Click a row in the list to show the edit panel here.
tree.demo.intro: A demo of the tree view's form factors and interactions. The data here is in-page sample data; a real app feeds it from a DataProvider.
tree.demo.explorerHint: Expand/collapse, single selection, rename with F2 or double-click, and drag to reorder/reparent.
tree.demo.multiHint: Tri-state checkboxes: toggling a parent cascades to its children, and a partial selection shows the indeterminate state.
tree.demo.gridHint: Passing columns turns the tree into a tree-grid with the tree as the first column.
tree.demo.lazyHint: Branches marked hasChildren fetch their children asynchronously on first expand (with loading/error states).
tree.demo.selectHint: A popover tree-select. Supports single selection and multi-selection with checkboxes.
customers.description: Billing destinations, closing days and payment terms
customers.codeAutoHint: Leave blank to auto-number as C001
projects.description: Projects and contract amounts per customer
projects.codeAutoHint: Leave blank to auto-number as YYYY-NNN
resource.notFoundDesc: It may have been deleted, or the URL is wrong.
workLogs.description: Hours and internal cost per project
workLogs.rateHint: Leave blank to use the category's default rate
expenses.description: Direct costs and receipts per project
trips.description: Register a trip and generate work logs and expenses
trips.generateHint: Creates travel (2 legs), on-site work (per day), transport and lodging. Fields left at 0 are skipped.
trips.generatedSummary: Created {workLogs} work logs and {expenses} expenses (cost {cost} JPY / expenses {amount} JPY)
trips.deleteWarning: This trip has {workLogs} work logs and {expenses} expenses. Deleting keeps those records and only removes the link.
costRates.title: Cost rates
costRates.description: Hourly rate per work category, used as the default for new work logs (past entries never change)
costRates.snapshotNote: Changing a rate never changes work logs already recorded - each row carries the rate applied at entry time.
profitability.title: Profitability
profitability.revenueBasisNote: Revenue is the tax-exclusive total of issued invoice lines. Work and expenses that have not been invoiced yet are not counted as revenue. Cost is labor cost plus direct expenses converted to tax-exclusive amounts.
profitability.uninvoicedBillable: {amount} of billable expenses have not been invoiced yet.
profitability.excludedFromAggregate: This project was lost, so it is excluded from the overall profitability aggregate.
profitability.loadErrorDesc: Please try reloading in a moment.
invoices.description: Create and issue invoices per customer
invoices.newDescription: Pick a customer and period to draw lines from uninvoiced work and expenses
invoices.noCandidates: No uninvoiced work or expenses in this period
invoices.candidatesNote: Amounts are computed by the server. Projects without a billing hourly rate show as 0 — set the rate on the project first.
invoices.amountNote: Line amounts are computed server-side as quantity × unit price, and update when you save.
invoices.totalsPending: Tax is calculated when the invoice is issued (rounded once per tax category).
invoices.issueConfirm: Issue this invoice? A number is assigned and the lines can no longer be edited.
invoices.cancelConfirm: Cancel this invoice? The work and expenses it covered return to uninvoiced.
invoices.issuedLocked: Issued invoices cannot be edited. Correct them by cancelling and issuing a new one.
invoices.dueOnHint: Leave blank to derive it from the customer's closing and payment terms when issuing
invoices.printDraftDesc: The invoice number and tax are decided at issue time. Issue it first.
issuer.title: Issuer settings
issuer.description: Issuer details printed on qualified invoices, and the consumption-tax rounding direction
issuer.roundingHint: Applied once per tax category, to the yen (negatives round toward zero)
issuer.snapshotNote: These values are snapshotted onto each invoice when it is issued. Changing them later never moves an already-issued invoice.
issuer.adminOnlyDesc: The registration number and bank account are app-wide settings — open this page with an administrator account.
payments.description: Record payments and allocate them to invoices
payments.newDescription: Record a payment and allocate it to open invoices (one payment can cover several invoices)
payments.noOpenInvoices: This customer has no open invoices
payments.differenceNote: A difference is an amount that closes the invoice without arriving as cash — a deducted transfer fee, a discount, or the excess of an overpayment. Choosing Other requires a note.
payments.unallocated: {amount} of this payment is not allocated to any invoice yet.
outstanding.title: Open and overdue invoices
invoices.settlementNote: Remaining, payment status and overdue are derived from the allocations each time — they are never stored.
outstanding.unavailable: Not available in demo mode. The browser-only demo has no business database, so this list only appears in the desktop app or over LAN access.
calendar.description: See missing work logs, closing dates, due dates and payments across a month
calendar.unavailable: Not available in demo mode. The browser-only demo has no business database, so the calendar only appears in the desktop app or over LAN access.
calendar.addWorkLog: Add a work log for this day
sync.title: Device sync
sync.description: Reconciles this device with the PC over your home LAN. Nothing is exposed to the internet.
sync.configureFirst: Set the PC address and username first.
sync.openConflicts: {count} unresolved conflict(s). The screen for choosing a side comes in a later version.
sync.passwordHint: Not stored on this device; remembered until the app closes.
sync.peerUrlHint: The address shown on the PC when LAN access is enabled.
sync.deviceIdHint: 0 for the PC, 1 for the phone. Each number gets its own id range.
sync.deviceIdLocked: Locked: this device already holds rows, and changing the number would make their ids collide with the other device.
sync.loadError: Could not load the sync settings.
sync.adminOnlyDesc: Sync settings are app-wide. Sign in as an administrator.
sync.desktopOnlyDesc: A sync always runs from the device that initiates it, so it is not available in a browser.
sync.scopeNote: Customers, projects, work logs, trips, expenses and the master tables sync. Invoices and payments are PC-only and never sync.
sync.conflictsHint: These rows were edited on both devices. Choose which version to keep — until you do, both devices keep their own.
sync.conflictInvoiced: This row is already invoiced. Cancel the invoice before overwriting it with this device's version.
